Layer: `core`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Inline fixed-capacity UTF-8 string over [u8; N]. All-or-nothing text/scalar pushes, boundary-respecting truncating push, scalar pop and checked truncate keep the bytes valid UTF-8. No allocation.
